description: This Java source file defines the class OpenmrsPropertyLookup, which extends AbstractLookup to expose certain OpenMRS properties (like application directory, log location, and log layout) for use in Log4j logging configuration. It provides a way to retrieve these properties dynamically within the logging context.

classes.name: OpenmrsPropertyLookup
classes.description: A class that provides a Log4j lookup for certain OpenMRS properties such as application directory, log location, and log layout.

methods.name: lookup
methods.description: Overrides the lookup method to return specific OpenMRS property values based on the provided key.

methods.name: getGlobalProperty
methods.description: Helper method to retrieve and trim a global property value using the AdministrationService.
